Privacy Policy

Effective Date: September 10, 2026

Ridgeway Services & Construction Ltd. ("Ridgeway," "we," "our," or "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you provide to us.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect personal information when you visit our website, contact us, or otherwise interact with Ridgeway through this website.

We aim to keep our privacy practices straightforward and easy to understand.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when you contact Ridgeway or submit an inquiry through our website.

Depending on how you interact with us, this may include:

  • Name
  • Email address
  • Phone number
  • Company or organization name
  • Project address or location
  • Information about your project, construction needs, or services requested
  • Any other information you choose to provide in a message or inquiry

We may also automatically collect limited technical information when you visit our website, such as your IP address, browser type, device type, pages visited, and general information about how visitors use the website. This information may be collected through cookies, analytics, or similar technologies if these tools are enabled on our website.

2. How We Use Your Information

We collect and use personal information for reasonable business purposes, including to:

  • Respond to inquiries and requests
  • Contact you about a potential or existing project
  • Understand your construction, renovation, maintenance, or other service requirements
  • Prepare estimates, proposals, or scopes of work
  • Provide and manage our services
  • Communicate with clients, landlords, leasing agents, contractors, and other project partners
  • Improve our website, services, and customer experience
  • Maintain appropriate business and project records
  • Protect the security and integrity of our website and systems
  • Meet legal, regulatory, insurance, or contractual requirements

We will not use personal information for a new purpose that is incompatible with the purpose for which it was originally collected without obtaining appropriate consent, unless otherwise permitted or required by law.

3. Consent

Where required by applicable law, Ridgeway will obtain your consent before collecting, using, or disclosing your personal information.

By voluntarily submitting information through our website—for example, by completing a contact form—you consent to Ridgeway collecting and using that information for the purpose of responding to your inquiry and communicating with you about the services or project you have asked us about.

You may withdraw your consent to certain uses of your personal information, subject to legal, contractual, or other reasonable restrictions. If you would like to withdraw consent or ask us about how your information is being used, please contact us using the information provided below.

Canadian privacy guidance emphasizes that consent should be meaningful and that people should understand what information is being collected, why it is being collected, and with whom it may be shared.

4. Information We Share

Ridgeway does not sell or rent your personal information.

We may disclose personal information when reasonably necessary to operate our business and provide our services. This may include sharing information with:

  • Service providers who assist us with website hosting, form processing, email, information technology, or other business functions
  • Contractors, consultants, trades, engineers, designers, or other project partners when necessary to provide requested services or manage a project
  • Professional advisors, such as legal, accounting, insurance, or financial professionals
  • Government authorities, regulators, courts, or law enforcement where required or permitted by law
  • Other parties where you have provided consent or where disclosure is otherwise permitted or required by law

We expect third-party service providers handling personal information on our behalf to use appropriate safeguards and to handle information only for authorized purposes.

5. Website Forms and Third-Party Services

Our website may use third-party services to operate contact forms, host website content, provide analytics, or support other website functions.

If we use a third-party service to process information submitted through a website form, the information you provide may be transmitted to and processed by that service in accordance with its own privacy practices.

Our website may also use analytics or similar technologies to understand website traffic and improve the site.

6. Cookies and Similar Technologies

Our website may use cookies or similar technologies to support website functionality, understand website usage, or improve the user experience.

Cookies are small files that may be stored on your device when you visit a website.

You can manage cookies through your browser settings, and you may choose to disable cookies if you prefer. However, some website features may not function properly if cookies are disabled.

7. Retention of Personal Information

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, provide our services, maintain appropriate business records, resolve disputes, protect our legitimate business interests, or meet legal, regulatory, insurance, or contractual requirements.

When personal information is no longer required, we take reasonable steps to securely delete, destroy, or anonymize it.

8. Protecting Your Information

Ridgeway takes reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect personal information against loss, theft, unauthorized access, disclosure, copying, use, modification, or destruction.

The safeguards we use may include appropriate access controls, passwords, secure systems, physical protections, and limiting access to personal information to individuals who need it for legitimate business purposes.

No method of transmitting or storing information electronically can be guaranteed to be completely secure. While we take reasonable measures to protect information, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Canadian privacy guidance requires safeguards appropriate to the sensitivity of the information being protected.

9. Information Provided by You

Please do not submit sensitive personal information through our website contact forms unless it is specifically requested and necessary for the purpose of your inquiry.

You are responsible for ensuring that information you provide to Ridgeway is accurate and, where applicable, that you have the authority to provide information relating to another individual or organization.

10. Accessing or Correcting Your Personal Information

You may request access to personal information Ridgeway holds about you and may request that inaccurate or incomplete information be corrected, subject to applicable legal requirements and exceptions.

To make a request, please contact:
Privacy Contact: Ridgeway Services & Construction Inc. Email: info@ridgewayservices.ca Telephone: 905-315-8887 Mailing Address: [object Object]

We may need to verify your identity before responding to a request involving personal information.

Canadian privacy principles generally provide individuals with rights to access their personal information and challenge its accuracy.

11. Privacy Questions or Complaints

If you have a question, concern, or complaint about how Ridgeway handles personal information, we encourage you to contact us first so that we can review and address the matter.

Please Contact:
Privacy Contact: Ridgeway Services & Construction Inc.
Email: info@ridgewayservices.ca
Telephone: 905-315-8887
Mailing Address: [object Object]

We will review privacy concerns and take reasonable steps to investigate and respond.

Individuals may also have the right to raise a privacy complaint with the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada or another applicable privacy regulator.

12. Changes to This Privacy Policy

Ridgeway may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes to our business practices, website, technology, or legal requirements.

When we make changes, we will update the "Effective Date" at the top of this policy. We encourage visitors to review this page periodically for the most current information.
